events.title: A SALUTE TO ROY ORBISON
events.location: The Showroom, 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: Direct from Las Vegas, YOU GOT IT! A SALUTE TO ROY ORBISON is an unforgettable concert experience, starring multi-award-winning artist John Stephan.    Superstar Roy Orbison was one of the world’s greatest and most successful rock’n’roll music legends of all time.    Wesley Orbison, Roy Orbison’s eldest son, is proud to fully endorse and present this show honouring and remembering his father. It features narration from Wesley, who delivers a very personal narrative of Roy’s intriguing yet tragic life.    Internationally renowned artist John Stephan has a voice filled with warmth, emotion and a four-octave range. Known as ‘The Voice’, John will take audience on an incredible trip through the storied career of Orbison, covering a multitude of his chart-topping hits.    Relive the glory days as John Stephan performs iconic songs such as Pretty Woman, Crying, I Drove All Night, Leah, Working for the Man, Blue Bayou, Only the Lonely, In Dreams, Blue Angel, You Got It, Running Scared and many more.    This is a concert experience not to be missed!

With over 13 years of experience performing to a wide variety of audiences, covering all styles of music including: Pop, Rock, Disco, Country etc. from the 1950's - Current Top 40, Cath & Him will have the crowd cheering for more. iF you're up for a sing-a-long, dance or even just to sit, relax and listen to, then you're in for a real treat when Cath & Him take the stage.

events.title: BODY & SOUL DUO
events.location: Club Banora Lounge, 2 Leisure Dr, Banora Point NSW 2486, Australia
events.description: Sandra Beynon (vocals, percussion) and Sean Mullen (guitar) present everything from jazz to country to RNB and funk to hard rock and metal – whatever the audience wants!    Their state-of-the-art customised backing tracks and full PA system deliver a great sound that belies its two-person presentation.  Over 900 tunes from the 50s right through to Top 10 will cover everyone’s taste.    Presentation, energy, professionalism of over 35 years in the industry, versatility and talent combined with percussion and cleverly integrated guitar laying means you won’t be disappointed.

events.title: SUPERCHEEZE
events.location: The Stage (18+), 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: “Supercheeze”, is based on the Northern Rivers of NSW. In early 2017 the decision was made to scratch off the mould, crank up the griller and once again melt some fine cheddar in the name of high-value entertainment.    The mission statement is simple; play upbeat ‘cheezy’ hit songs that many will know, with a positive vibe, great musicianship, high quality production, get everyone in the audience dancing, singing, laughing, and generally having a grand old time.    The Supercheeze fondue-pot consists of Roy Wilders on lead vocals (when he’s not touring his native Ireland in search of the elusive mozzarell potato) Mick Dunham on guitar and co-lead vocals, Dean Jones on guitar and co-lead vocals, Greg Strong on bass guitar and co-lead vocals. And sitting behind the kit with occasional lead vocals Mark Bridges, who once claimed the title of downhill cheese-rolling champion of Clunes three years consecutively……..amazing!    So just remember……when life gets you down, don’t just whine, get some ‘Cheeze’ into you, and dance the night away!

events.title: BRIT BEAT MANIA
events.location: The Showroom, 2 Wharf st, Tweed Heads, NSW 2486
events.description: Brit Beat Mania  Brit Beat Mania - are widely regarded as one of Queensland’s best Pop Tribute Show Bands as  they re-create the look, the sound and the magic that was The British Invasion.  Their professionally presented show has been wowing audiences taking Baby Boomers back to  their teens with an entertaining, fun, and interactive journey with songs from legendary artists  such as Cliff Richard, Herman’s Hermits, The Hollies, Tom Jones, Gerry & the Pacemakers, The  Beatles, The Rolling Stones and the many more who created the British Invasion.  Tony Worsley  Tony Worsley burst into the Australian recording industry in the early 60's and his  success was instantaneous. Hit after hit including "Missing You", "Raining in my Heart",  "Knocking on Wood" as well as the Gold single "Velvet Waters".  In 1965 Tony toured nationally with The Kinks, Manfred Mann and The Honeycombs, playing to  packed houses of screaming fans. Tony has shared the stage with The Dave Clark Five, The  Seekers, Johnny O'Keefe and John Farnham.  Tony’s onstage personality is full of charisma and his presentation is as vibrant and polished now  as that of any world-class entertainer.  So be ready to be entertained and transported back to the era that changed the musical  landscape around the world that was The Sound of the 60’s.
